title: Mixed Duo #06
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Japanese, in her early 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, huge voluminous light-brown curls with a big pink satin bow, a sweet princess-like smile, low bun hair, real pores, real living eyes, 200 segment rings piercings set with rubies in brass-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal earrings. Painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer, deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold-leaf bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme gold-leaf extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Filipina, in her mid 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, long voluminous chestnut waves, a bright, confident pageant smile, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 5 segment rings piercings set with amethysts in silver-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal a hair ornament. Painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery, a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide white bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, hands resting on her thigh, extreme white extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
